product.name: Maximal Platform
product.description: A cloud-native platform that enables developers to specify business logic and workflows declaratively and expose them as services using constraint logic programming.

product.name: Complex Decision Services
product.description: Services that provide explainable decisions and analytics for complex business logic scenarios, such as underwriting and risk assessment.

product.name: Complex Event Processing
product.description: Real-time processing and reaction to events for applications like fraud detection and compliance monitoring.

product.name: Dynamic Case Management
product.description: Solutions for managing knowledge worker tasks and workflows dynamically, adapting to changing case requirements.
